contentText:
Fuerza Regida were the big winners of the 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards—plus Rosalía, Peso Pluma and Tito Double P delivered major moments all night. Here’s your full 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards recap from Miami, including the biggest performances, tributes and awards.

From Víctor Manuelle and Elvis Crespo kicking off the show to Becky G and Ryan Castro presenting Top Latin Album of the Year to Peso Pluma & Tito Double P, the night was packed with highlights. Rosalía received the Billboard Hall of Fame Award and won Best Latin Pop Album for Lux , while Fuerza Regida collected multiple trophies, including Streaming Song of the Year and the Vanguard Award. Plus: Wisin & Ivy Queen reunited onstage, an emotional Juan Gabriel tribute honored the 10th anniversary of his passing, and Cristian Castro received the Billboard Lifetime Achievement Award.

Jessica Roiz 

Fuerza Regida. The night belonged to Fuerza Regida. The global phenomenon group were the big winners of the Billboard Latin Music Awards. Superstar Rosalía also had a huge night. We saw spectacular performances from Tito Double P, Wisin and Ivy Queen, Elvis Crespo and more. And Cristian Castro got everyone on their feet with his performance and when accepting the Billboard Lifetime Achievement Award. It was an unforgettable night, but we want you not to forget that you can also win big. Monopoly returned to McDonald’s with many prizes, from cash, trips and vehicles. Plus, each play gives you one in five chances to win free food from McDonald’s. Take off and play on the McDonald’s app for the chance to win. So go get yours. Now let’s get back to our recap of the Billboard Latin Music Awards. Live from Miami, the show kicked off with a performance by Víctor Manuelle and the one and only Elvis Crespo performing “La Gozadera en Navidad.” The first award of the night, Top Latin Album of the Year, presented by Becky G and Ryan Castro, went to Peso Pluma and Tito Double P for Dinastía . Tito Double P also accepted a few more trophies for his collab with Peso and also sang his hit “Nadie.” Spanish goddess Rosalía was the woman of the night, honored with the Billboard Hall of Fame award and shared her musical inspirations in her acceptance speech. Rosalía also won Best Latin Pop Album of the year for Lux .
